tuesday.name: Day 1: Tuesday — Posterior Chain & Horizontal Power
tuesday.focus: Hamstrings, upper back thickness, neutral chest pressing, rotational core stability.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift (or Hex Bar)
exercises.notes: Lower lumbar and knee shear than conventional deadlifts; builds pure hip drive and grip.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Palms face each other. Eliminates internal rotation and saves anterior shoulder capsules.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell / Machine Row
exercises.notes: Takes lower back out of the equation while building rhomboids and mid-traps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
exercises.notes: Hamstring and glute focus. Controlled eccentric (3 sec down).

exercises.name: Face Pulls (Cable or Band)
exercises.notes: Non-negotiable for boxers: external rotators and rear delts to keep shoulders healthy.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raises / Captain's Chair
exercises.notes: Decompresses the spine while building anti-extension core strength.

thursday.name: Day 2: Thursday — Unilateral Balance & Vertical Pull
thursday.focus: Single-leg stability, lat strength, controlled upper chest, and shoulder joint integrity.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Dumbbells at sides)
exercises.notes: Builds single-leg power and hip stability without loading spine with heavy barbell.

exercises.name: Weighted or Bodyweight Pull-Ups / Chin-Ups
exercises.notes: Lat width and pulling power. Use neutral grip if elbows/shoulders feel tight.

exercises.name: Low-Incline Dumbbell Press (30° Angle)
exercises.notes: Keep elbows tucked at 45°. Targets upper chest with minimal front-delt impingement.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
exercises.notes: Strict form, slight forward lean, lead with elbows. Builds side-delt width cleanly.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof Press
exercises.notes: Anti-rotational core strength directly transfers to punch stability.
